## Summary

| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|---------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Fold14 MDD | **-9.31%** | -9.97% |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

**Observation**: Champion holds lead on tuning metrics and drawdown control. Last PASS candidate shows slightly better lockbox minimum (more robust floor) but significantly worse worst-case MDD (-11.2% vs -9.3%).

## Ready to Execute

```bash
# 1. Module-level autopilot - find best AUB modules
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best

# 2. System-level autopilot - test system configurations
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate next fix recommendations
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Shall I proceed with execution? Or is there a specific command you'd like to run first / any parameters to adjust?
